manual_control_flow_findings: six_state requires exactly one of each target and exact complete old or new six-object JSON state, preserving boolean/integer/float distinctions and rejecting mixed/unknown fields.
before_annotation permits only all six PTS fields absent or the exact annotated state. Partial PTS absence refuses; no global canonical digest is imposed on normal builder preannotation output.

Whole original book hash, source-book index, target state, member/share dependencies and four unchanged neighbor spans are checked before any target metadata update. All three pairs advance atomically.
Absent source book is an explicit builder omission no-op. An already-new complete state returns no changes only after the same source/group/neighbor gates.

The historical inverse replaces only exact six target metadata records while preserving unrelated deliberate changes. Its lack of full-global pin is intentional; it must never rebase runtime/private positions.

CLI separately enforces full historical C1 inverse and entire commentary hashes, exact XML SHA/blob and parsed entire original book, real commentary associations and accepted source-prefix intersections.

CLI deep-copies unit metadata before the low-level repair; existing Builder annotation runs against separate book/unit copies and is compared with independently pinned PTS. Source words and commentary are not mutated.

CLI requires the exact final0f9 hash before publishing canon.units; this is the sole caller-visible mutation. Old input advances once; complete future input inverses to exact C1 and returns an idempotent no-change repair.

CLI paths must resolve to four different values and the output must not already exist or be a symlink. Gzip output creation is after all validation; no output is written on validation failure. Filesystem write-failure atomicity is not established by this source review.

Build hook adds exactly one import and one invocation, after older333 repair and before Thag16/numbering/page annotation. It does not use a postannotation whole-canon hash to gate normal builder inputs.
required_runtime_validation: Strict six-state positive/negative tests, missing/duplicate/mixed/type/title/number/PTS/revision and source drift cases.
All-absent preannotation positive plus partial/mixed PTS negatives; omit-book and existing-new idempotence.
Unrelated deliberate mutation preserved by scoped inverse but refused by the CLI full-global guard.
Actual pinned XML/annotation repair produces exact0f9 and idempotent second result; validation failures leave input/output untouched.
All89 old/current locator/refusal/export/private-draft behavior and final package/CI receipts remain separate required gates.
limitations: AST/literal/data reads and static inspection only: no proposed helper/Builder/app import or execution, no tests/build/Git/network/project edits.
This GO covers frozen source files only, not application safety, passing tests, source activation, personal-data migration or release approval.
The low-level builder gate intentionally checks only the reviewed target source/neighbor dependencies; full unrelated-corpus identity is enforced by the separate CLI.
